_notes.decisions_2026_11_23: User decisions (relayed by the manuscript session): Part 1 compares the four methods in confirmatory tests: per scale a Friedman test and the six pairwise Wilcoxon tests with Holm within the scale (scales corrected separately). Part 2: P4a = mean of per-participant H - F with a within-participant permutation test, tested alone; P4b tested at alpha only if P4a is significant. SSQ numbers only. See docs/E5_AnalysisPlan_20261121.md.
_notes.part1_pairs: (reference, test); the reported difference is test - reference.
_notes.include_aborted_partial: User 2026-11-23: an aborted session is not redone; its completed trials enter the analysis (Part 1 clips rated under both conditions of a pair, Part 2 H - F when at least one real and one identical pair were answered, SSQ measurements filled). Aborted participants do not count toward the 30 completed participants.
_notes.sensitivity_complete_only: Suggested by the manuscript session: results of complete sessions only, reported as a sensitivity analysis.
_notes.head_deviation_threshold_deg: Decided not to set (null): Part 2 interrupts and replays a segment online when the head leaves the tolerance; the analysis reports the deviation distribution only.
_notes.stereo_pass_rule: User 2026-11-23: pass = both trials correct at the 4 px level (the largest formal level); the 2 px and 1 px levels are reported only. A participant who fails is excluded from the analysis.
